text:
dara: Quick scope huddle. Pilot wants low-friction observability: per-route cost slice (7d), error -> trace jump links, and a tiny default dashboard. Can we define a minimal, low-risk MVP we can ship behind a flag in ~7 days?
li: Short answer: yes if we keep capture additive-only and Hosted-first. Backend has route tags; we need a per-route aggregator + small frontend tile. Trace jump is just canonicalizing trace URLs if trace_id present.
marco: Risks: any capture pipeline change triggers retention/egress costs and PII concerns. Proposal: default capture OFF globally, opt-in per org. Sampling default 0.001 (0.1%). Add an automated scrub step for common PII patterns before persisting.
dara: Agree. Proposed minimal launch criteria: 1) Hosted per-route cost panel (7d rollup) behind flag; 2) Error detail shows trace_id and a click-to-open trace link when trace exists; 3) One dashboard template (cost sparkline, error rate, recent traces); 4) Feature flag + documented canary plan.
li: Implementation sketch: cost aggregator service + small query endpoint, UI tile reusing billing API, flag name `obs-mini-2026`. ETA: service PR by Tue, UI by Thu.
marco: Legal/Compliance ask: need signoff for scrub rules before enabling for pilot. I'll draft a short checklist for legal: sampling rate, retention days, scrub regexes, storage location.
dara: Prioritization: if pilot signs today we make it top of sprint. Otherwise drop trace UI polish and ship cost + dashboard first, trace capture deferred.
li: Canary plan: enable `obs-mini-2026` for pilot org only in us-west-2 for 48h, monitor trace ingress and cost delta. Add alert: trace_ingress_rate > 2x baseline => auto-disable flag.
marco: Ops automation: add short runbook with step to flip flag, rollback, and how to purge captured traces for an org. Also include how to revoke access if PII found.
dara: Acceptance checklist to include: flag present; dashboard renders with pilot data; trace link opens trace if present; sampling + retention configurable; legal ack recorded; canary metrics stable for 48h.
ops-bot: Feature flag created: `obs-mini-2026` scoped to pilot org in us-west-2.
dara: I'll follow up by pinging solutions and legal, and will update the roadmap doc with these criteria. If pilot confirms, expect an all-hands sprint bump.
li: I'll add the sampling default and scrub middleware to the PR.
marco: I'll prepare legal checklist and runbook draft.
dara: Thanks. Posting summary to roadmap and will create a follow-up thread with PR links.
